composition: Use a symmetrical, centered layout with the focal point (text or logo) occupying 50% to 70% of the central canvas.
For character-driven designs, flank the central text symmetrically with 2 characters occupying 30% of the left and right margins, or place a couple centrally occupying the middle 50%.
For asymmetrical layouts, use a 35/65 split: a solid color block with text on the left 35%, and a wide-angle scene with a foreground element on the right 65%.
Frame the composition using blurred foreground elements (e.g., 3D assets, snowflakes, or foliage) to establish depth of field.
typographie: Place a giant, bold, sans-serif or custom display title centrally behind the main subjects, or use a large monogram (occupying 30% width) on the left that merges into the main text.
Apply a strict hierarchy: main title in ultra-bold, uppercase, or 3D extruded block style; secondary subtitle (e.g., 'ROLEPLAY') in a smaller, tracked-out, clean sans-serif centered below.
Integrate text with graphic elements, such as a central icon acting as a vertical word separator, or sharp horizontal slice effects through the lettering.
lumiere: Implement high-contrast, low-key lighting with a vibrant neon or ambient glow (purple, green, or red) emanating from behind the central text to separate it from dark backgrounds.
For outdoor scenes, use bright, direct midday or afternoon sunlight with strong rim lighting on the characters' shoulders and hair to create a premium cutout effect.
etalonnage: Apply high-contrast, saturated color palettes: pair deep, crushed blacks and dark grays (#1A1A1A) with vibrant accents like hot pink (#FF007F), electric green (#00FF66), or cyan (#00D2FF).
For thematic designs, use a monochromatic wash (deep crimson #8B0000, deep purple #2D1B33, or cyan/teal #005F73) contrasted with stark white text.
effets: Apply depth-of-field blur to foreground and background elements to create a 3D layer effect.
Incorporate subtle graphic overlays: topographic vector lines in the corners, fine halftone dot patterns, and light dust or particle textures.
logo: Integrate the logo directly into the typography as a customized monogram (e.g., 'B' or 'D' on the left) or embed a stylized icon within the central lettering.
interdits: Avoid harsh, low-resolution cutouts or jagged edges on character models.
Do not make background characters so dark that they lose all defining detail.
Avoid abrupt, disjointed transitions between solid color blocks and photographic scenes.
Do not use generic, unedited stock brushes or low-resolution, sparse particle effects.
